description_text: This 3D model was originally created with Sketchup 8 and then converted to all other 3D formats. Native format is .skp 3dsmax scene is 3ds Max 2016 version, rendered with Vray 3.00 Chongsi Building in Xuhui High School Xujiahui source Chong think House is one of the components, the Shanghai outstanding listed building, Xuhui District cultural relics protection units. Earlier Xuhui Middle School (formerly the Xuhui Public School) of the main building. The school in 1850 to create, now covering 38.6 acres. Chong Si House in January 8, 1917 placed the first stone. June 20, 1918 completed, Shanghai celebrity-studded inauguration ceremony, Lu Yongxiang Songhu Hujun make generals attended the ceremony, the Qing Shanghai Shen Baochang prefectural governor attended the groundbreaking ceremony. Sung Si floor by the Belgian priest, architect and the first design sketches Disney Rendu workers, was called "new school." 1992 renamed "Si Chong floor." Chong even thought the whole building floor attic of four, presenting the French classical architectural design and ancient Greek art of combining classic architectural style. Facade of masonry, interior wooden structure based. Top also had the use of Spanish architectural style, but in the early 1990s due to serious leaking and demolition. Sung Si-floor 孟莎 style beautiful contour, and there is uneven change, is divided into Sec lower section is steep, open French-style dormer windows, the upper relatively flat, open some stingy windows, roof paved with slate gray basket. The whole building brick facade of water, hook gold seam, five sections of the longitudinal approach taken three segments, re-use triangles and mountain fancy curved window lintel on the overall design of the building. The size of each building with a hall, auditorium on the top floor, a small auditorium on the ground floor. Chong thought the building is now a small hall, office, library, music and other fine arts classrooms. Sung Si House completed in 2010 the last renovation.

description_text:
Outdoor bench 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 9316 vertices, 9020 quad faces (18040 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
DE: Ein Hydrant (von griechisch ὕδωρ hydor ‚Wasser’) ist eine Armatur zur Entnahme von Wasser aus einem Wasserverteilungssystem.
In der Regel werden durch den Wasserversorger festgelegte Hydranten als Teil der zentralen Löschwasserversorgung von Städten und Gemeinden genutzt. Er ermöglicht der Feuerwehr, aber auch öffentlichen (z. B. Straßenmeisterei, Stadtbetriebe) und privaten (z. B. Straßenreinigungsfirmen, Zeltfestveranstaltern) Nutzern die Wasserentnahme aus dem öffentlichen Wasserleitungsnetz (Sammelwasserversorgung).
Hydranten werden genutzt um eine Rohrleitung zu spülen, zu entlüften oder zu entspannen. Im Falle des Ausfalls eines Leitungsabschnittes sind sie dafür gedacht Notverbindungen mit Schläuchen herzustellen.
Spezielle Hinweisschilder weisen im öffentlichen Raum auf Unterflurhydranten hin.
Der Begriff ist auch für Entnahmestellen für andere Flüssigkeiten, beispielsweise Flugbenzin aus einer Pipeline üblich.
EN:
A hydrant (from Greek ὕδωρ hydor, water ') is a tap for the removal of water from a water distribution system.
As a rule, hydrants established by the water supply are used as part of the central low-water supply of cities and municipalities. It allows users to extract water from the public water supply network (collection water supply) to the fire brigade, but also to public authorities (eg road authorities, municipal companies) and private (eg road cleaning companies, tent festivals).
Hydrants are used to flush, ventilate or relax a pipeline. In the event of a line failure, they are intended to produce emergency connections with hoses.
Special signs in the public area point to underfloor hydrants.
The term is also common for collection points for other liquids, for example, airborne gas from a pipeline.

Svetlana

People usually use nightlights for the sense of security which having a light on provides, or to relieve fear of the dark, especially in young children. Exit signs often use tritium in the form of a traser. Homeowners usually place nightlights in bathrooms, kitchens and hallways to avoid turning on the main light fixture, especially late at night, and causing their eyes to adjust to the brighter light.[1]
Some frequent travelers carry small nightlights for temporary installation in their guestroom and bathroom, to avoid tripping or falls in an unfamiliar nighttime environment. Gerontologists have recommended use of nightlights to prevent falls, which can be life-threatening to the elderly.[2]
The low cost of nightlights has enabled a proliferation of different decorative designs, some featuring superheros and fantastical designs, while others feature the basic simplicity of a small luminous disc.

description_text:
Rotating turnstile gate 3D Model. 2 individual objects (base, rotating part; so, you can easily rotate or even animate it) sharing the same non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
2 Objects (meshes), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 33220 vertices, 33218 quad faces (66436 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Obito Uchiha (うちはオビト, Uchiha Obito) was a member of Konohagakure's Uchiha clan. He was believed to have died during the Third Shinobi World War, his only surviving legacy being the Sharingan he gave to his teammate, Kakashi Hatake. In truth, Obito was saved from death and trained by Madara Uchiha, but the events of the war left Obito disillusioned with reality, and he inherited Madara's plan to create an ideal world. Resurfacing under the names of Tobi (トビ, Tobi) and Madara Uchiha himself, Obito subtly took control of the Akatsuki, using them as a means to advance his machinations, eventually going public and starting the Fourth Shinobi World War. However, towards the war's conclusion, Obito had a change of heart and, as atonement, sacrificed his life to save the same world he sought to replace.

description_text:
Hi I am Frezzy from Vnvisual studio.
This model is high quality, photo real model that will enhance detail and realism to any of your rendering projects.
The model has a fully textured, detailed design that allows for close-up renders, and was originally modeled in 3ds Max 2012 and rendered with V-Ray.
Fidelity is optimal up to a 4k render. Renders have no postprocessing.
This model is ready to be animated. You can easily position it the way you need or animate.
+++++++++++++++
Features:

  - High quality polygonal model, correctly scaled for an accurate representation of the original object.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - All colors can be easily modified.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied.

  - All textures and materials are included and mapped in every format.

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

+++++++++++++++
File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2012 V-Ray ( 2.4 ) and standard materials scenes

  - OBJ 2012 (Multi Format)

  - 3DS 2012 (Multi Format)

  - FBX 2012 (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2012 with standard materials

  - Cinema 4D R12 with standard materials

+++++++++++++++
Textures: ( just for the models have textures )
  - High resolution ( up to 4096x4096 pixels for big parts and 2048x2048 pixels for small parts ).
+++++++++++++++

  - NOTE for Cinima 4D users: add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - NOTE: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )

+++++++++++++++
About Vnvisual:
We are a team of 3D artists with over a decade of experience in the field. My team participated in various projects allowing us to learn our clients needs.
Every model we build goes through thorough quality assessment both visual and technical to make sure the assets look realistic and the models are of the best quality, which you can tell by looking at the renders none of the has any postprocessing.
On the top of that all the models come with complete UVs and optimized topology, which allows you in no time alter geo or the textures if needed.
  - Also check out our other models, just click on my user name to see complete gallery.

description_text:
Developed from the GAZ-69, UAZ-471 and UAZ-460,[3] the UAZ-469 was introduced in 1971 to replace the GAZ-69. It was powered by the same 75 hp (56 kW; 76 PS) 2,445 cc (149.2 cu in) UMZ-452MI inline-four engine as the UAZ-452 and was able to run on gasoline with an octane rating as low as 72 (although 76 was preferred).[4] The UAZ-469 presented two great advantages: it was able to drive in virtually any terrain and it was very easy to repair. The vehicle was originally not available for purchase by the public, but many were sold as surplus to private owners. (Information from Wikipedia)

description_text:
Half timbered inn (or pub, tavern) 3D Model. 3 individual objects (concrete, wood, glass), each one with its own non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures sets. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
3 Objects (meshes), 3 PBR Materials, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 12966 vertices, 12620 quad faces (25240 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

Prostitution in Hong Kong is itself legal, but organised prostitution is illegal, as there are laws against keeping a vice establishment, causing or procuring another to be a prostitute, living on the prostitution of others, or public solicitation.[1]
The most visible public venues for workers in Hong Kong, especially for tourists, are massage parlours and the so-called Japanese style night clubs. However, most of the commercial worker industry consists of women working in small, usually one room apartments, usually referred to as one-woman brothels, the equivalent of the walk-up brothel in the United Kingdom. They advertise for clients through the Internet and local classifieds. Most popular mainstream newspapers will carry such classifieds with brothel guides as an insert within racing form guides. Yellow neon advertising boxes were used to advertise services to such an extent that yellow (黃) became synonymous with prostitution.[citation needed]

description_text: Batman comics were among those criticized when the comic book industry came under scrutiny with the publication of psychologist Fredric Wertham's book Seduction of the Innocent in 1954. Wertham's thesis was that children imitated crimes committed in comic books, and that these works corrupted the morals of the youth. Wertham criticized Batman comics for their supposed homosexual overtones and argued that Batman and Robin were portrayed as lovers.[37] Wertham's criticisms raised a public outcry during the 1950s, eventually leading to the establishment of the Comics Code Authority, a code that is no longer in use by the comic book industry. The tendency towards a sunnier Batman in the postwar years intensified after the introduction of the Comics Code.[38] Scholars have suggested that the characters of Batwoman (in 1956) and the pre-Barbara Gordon Bat-Girl (in 1961) were introduced in part to refute the allegation that Batman and Robin were gay, and the stories took on a campier, lighter feel.

The Flag of Indonesia is a simple bicolor with two equal horizontal bands, red (top) and white (bottom) with an overall ratio of 2:3.[1] It was introduced and hoisted in public during the Proclamation of Indonesian Independence on 17 August 1945 in at 56 Jalan Proklamasi (formerly Jalan Pegangsaan Timur) in Jakarta, and again when the Dutch formally transferred sovereignty on 27 December 1949. The design of the flag has remained unchanged since.
The flag of Indonesia is graphically similar to the Flag of Monaco, with a slight difference in the shade of red, and ratio of its dimensions. The flag of Poland has similar dimensions but has the colours reversed: white on top and red on the bottom. In both, the red is of a slightly darker shade.

description_text:
The Blue Engine 4 or BE-4 is an oxygen-rich liquefied-natural-gas-fueled staged-combustion rocket engine under development by Blue Origin. The BE-4 is being developed with private and public funding. The engine has been designed to produce 2.4 meganewtons (550,000 lbf) of thrust at sea level.It was initially planned for the engine to be used exclusively on a Blue Origin proprietary launch vehicle New Glenn, the company's first orbital rocket. However, it was announced in 2014 that the engine would also be used on the United Launch Alliance (ULA) Vulcan Centaur launch vehicle, the successor to the Atlas V launch vehicle. Final engine selection by ULA happened in September 2018.
The model was created in the Fusion 360 program. You can use it as part of your rocket model.

description_text:
Asset BreakdownHere is a simple explanation of what makes this model special and how it is designed:

  - The Overall Concept This asset is a specialized Game Viewer vehicle, modified from a standard pickup truck for safari tours. It is designed to carry tourists through wildlife parks, offering an open and unobstructed view of animals in their natural habitat.

  - Tiered Stadium Seating The rear cargo bed has been replaced with three rows of raised seats. This stadium-style layout ensures that passengers sitting in the back are higher up than those in the front, giving everyone a perfect view over the driver's head.

  - Protective Canvas Canopy A light beige fabric roof stretches over the entire seating area, supported by a black metal frame. This canvas cover protects passengers from the harsh jungle sun or sudden rainstorms without blocking the fresh air.

  - Heavy-Duty Safety Cage Surrounding the passenger area is a network of black steel bars and railings. These keep the tourists safely inside the vehicle while driving over bumpy terrain and provide a sturdy handhold when standing up to take photos.

  - Rugged Utility Base The front of the truck features a tough green body with a heavy black bull bar protecting the grille. Along the sides, there are metal steps welded to the frame to help passengers climb up into the high seats easily.

Technical NotesFiles Included: FBX, GLB, OBJ, STL, ZIP (Textures). Quick Tip: The Canvas Roof is a single thin sheet. Be sure to use a Two-Sided material in your game engine so the fabric is visible when the player looks up from inside the vehicle, otherwise it might disappear.

Ancient Egyptian deities are the gods and goddesses worshipped in ancient Egypt. The beliefs and rituals surrounding these gods formed the core of ancient Egyptian religion, which emerged sometime in prehistory. Deities represented natural forces and phenomena, and the Egyptians supported and appeased them through offerings and rituals so that these forces would continue to function according to maat, or divine order. After the founding of the Egyptian state around 3100 BC, the authority to perform these tasks was controlled by the pharaoh, who claimed to be the gods' representative and managed the temples where the rituals were carried out.
The gods' complex characteristics were expressed in myths and in intricate relationships between deities: family ties, loose groups and hierarchies, and combinations of separate gods into one. Deities' diverse appearances in art—as animals, humans, objects, and combinations of different forms—also alluded, through symbolism, to their essential features.

description_text:
These days, the term longsword most frequently refers to a late Medieval and Renaissance weapon designed for use with two hands. The German langes Schwert (long sword) in 15th-century manuals did not necessarily denote a type of weapon, but the technique of fencing with both hands at the hilt.
The French épée bâtarde and the English bastard sword originate in the 15th or 16th century, originally having the general sense of irregular sword or sword of uncertain origin. Qui n'était ni Française, ni Espagnole, ni proprement Lansquenette, mais plus longue que ces fortes épées. (which was neither French, nor Spanish, nor properly Landsknecht, but longer than any of these sturdy swords.) Espée bastarde could also historically refer to a single-handed sword with a fairly long blade compared to other short swords.
All textures are made in 4k resolution. A low-poly ready-to-game model.You can re-size textures inside the engine.
All texture UV are separated.

description_text:
The Gun Axe or Axe-Pistol was a late 16th century invention that proved quite brutal at close-ranged combat!
The Axe-Pistol is definitely a quite complex weapon to wield. This model was inspired by the idea of having a magnificent close quarters weapon being quite letal in many ways: the main cutting blade is made of Damascus steel which once sharpened to its peak is capable of slashing very hard surfaces; on the opposite side sits a toothed blade that can efficiently slash through any organic material with ease; at the bottom of the weapon the spike can be used to pierce which is an advantage depending which foe you are facing, especially while hunting; last but not least, its crown jewel - a long cane pistol (much as a rifle barrel) capable of firing a high powered shot once needed. The weapon also has extra bullet slots made of silicone for those moments that you know you'll need to go guns blazing towards victory!
You will get:
The Axe Gun low polygon model, complete with its UV unwrap and a backup of the model before modifiers have been applied for any tweaks.The textures Winrar file used during the process of making this asset.A good collection of materials even the spare ones of the moment of making this project on a Winrar file.
This Axe Gun model is very easily adjustable for any customizations you might want to add and the Nodes are also organized in a simple maner for better user management. Included once you buy the model there is a native Blender file (.blend), and other formats such as .fbx, .stl and .obj.
This project was done using the most up-to-date version of Blender, which is currently version 2.90.

Do you need an outpost or watchtower for your game or project?
In this pack, you will find five unique outposts that are well optimized and look great up close and afar. Rendered within blender and unity these watchtowers look really nice. The files are optimized well to use a minimum number of draw calls by sharing a single texture sheet and using the power of material instancing with Unity, Unreal Engine, or the game engine of your choice.
Each model:
∙ uses a 2k PBR texture setup
∙ is less than 2,100 tris
∙ has a UV channel prepared for lightmapping
∙ uses materials that can be used interchangeably   
A perfect fit especially for the survival/horror genre, or anywhere a derelict building of this fashion may be useful.  You are provided a very easy to use, efficient, and customizable model ready for any purpose.  
Any questions, suggestions, or critiques please feel free to contact me at the links provided on my profile,
thanks!

Renders were done in 3ds Max and V-Ray renderer.
The rendering scenes are not included.

description_text:
This is a realistic 3D model of a fridge magnet souvenir. It is meant for either rendering or 3d printing.

  - Model is scaled to real world scale in metric units, and is placed very near / above the ground.

  - Mesh is unique (only one object), 100% quads and completely watertight.

  - STL file has 6 level iteration subdivision and displacement already applied, so the polygon and vertices number is completely different. It is ready for 3d print.

  - Two OBJ Files with different subdivision levels: one with no subdivisions or displacement applied, the other with 6 iterations and displacement applied.

  - The model has diffuse, normal, specular and displacement maps. All 4096x4096 in resolution. When rendering, the normal map should only be used if the displacement map is not used. Otherwise, the results might not be as good.

  - All textures are in PNG format.

  - Redshift, Corona, V-Ray, Arnold and Default materials included for 3ds Max. V-Ray materials for Cinema4D. Default standard materials for Blender, OBJ and FBX version.

  - No isolated vertices, no overlapping vertices or faces, no missing textures.

Renders were done in 3ds Max and V-Ray renderer.
The rendering scenes are not included.

description_text:
Low poly Racing car INCLUDED! Only exterior modeled.
Very detailed sci fi tunnel for racing cars exhibition / showroom / exposition built in Blender and rendered with Cycles, with PBR materials made in substance painter, UV unwrapped and optimized. Model is ready for VR and webGL visualization. Low poly car included with scene. The design is modular and the tunnel can be easily customized using arrays and mirrors. An endless tunnel can be made. Number of parts and texture set has been reduced to a minimum. 
Tris count of single set of modules (wall + ground + ground prop + screen): 2863.
Size: 12.4m x 35.5m x 3.94m.
File formats: .blend, rendered with cycles, glb with textures .fbx, .stl; glb with materials applied (a preview is inclueded of how it looks on a online viewer) and textures, obj and usdz.
3D Software: This 3d model was originally created in Blender 4.0 and rendered with Cycles/GLTF online viewer.
Materials and textures: Materials and textures following PBR workflow. The model has materials applied in blender and glb, and is ready to import and render . Texture set in 4K included.
Preview scenes: The preview images are rendered in Blender using its built-in render engine 'Cycles'. Camera and lightning setup is included with the file.
For any problems please feel free to contact me.

description_text:
Modular escalator animated

  - The total size of the model is roughly 0.44 by 2.48 by 1.28 meters and it is modular.

  - It is separated into top, middle, and bottom parts, you can repeat or overlap the middle section to extend the length of the escalator. and then scale the middle railing as necessary as used in the animation preview.

  - the animation is looping 25 frames, available in formats .blend and .abc and armature fbx animation.

  - Low poly: 1712vertices, 1430faces.

  - PBR 4k textures: 2 diffuse options, AO, roughness, tangient normal, alpha, and metalness.

  - UV unwrapped: overlapping UVs to preserve the texture details.

  - Available animated formats: blend, abc and fbx.

  - Available non animated formats: obj, gITF, dae, and stl.

  - Materials .blend file is also included.

  - 
  - Update February 2024: added some updated versions with better UV unwrapping after some customers' feedback, updated files are labelled Escalator updated ... for the formats blend, abc, usdc, fbx, glb, obj, and dae

description_text:
This is a model very refined, and formats are converted from 3dmax.It will take time to load.
Big Ben is the nickname for the Great Bell of the Great Clock of Westminster,[1][2] and, by extension, for the clock tower itself,[3] which stands at the north end of the Palace of Westminster in London, England.[4] Originally named the Clock Tower, it was renamed Elizabeth Tower in 2012 to mark the Diamond Jubilee of Queen Elizabeth II. The clock is a striking clock with five bells.[2]
It was designed by Sir Charles Barry and Augustus Pugin in the Perpendicular Gothic and Gothic Revival styles and was completed in 1859. It is elaborately decorated with stone carvings and features symbols related to the four countries of the United Kingdom and the Tudor dynasty. A Latin inscription celebrates Queen Victoria, under whose reign the palace was built.[5] It stands 316 feet (96 m) tall, and the climb from ground level to the belfry is 334 steps. Its base is square, measuring 40 feet (12 m) on each side. The dials of the clock are 22.5 feet (6.9 m) in diameter.
The clock uses its original mechanism and was the largest and most accurate four-faced striking and chiming clock in the world upon its completion.[6] It was designed by Edmund Beckett Denison and George Airy, the Astronomer Royal, and constructed by Edward John Dent and Frederick Dent. It is known for its reliability, and can be adjusted by adding or removing pre-decimal pennies from the pendulum. The Great Bell was cast by the Whitechapel Bell Foundry and weighs 13.5 long tons (13.7 tonnes; 15.1 short tons).[4] Its nickname derives from that of the tall Sir Benjamin Hall, who oversaw its installation. There are four quarter bells, which chime on the quarter hours.
Big Ben is a British cultural icon. It is a prominent symbol of Britain and parliamentary democracy,[7] and is often used in the establishing shot of films set in London.[8] It has been part of a Grade I listed building since 1970, and in 1987 it was designated by UNESCO as a World Heritage Site.[9] The clock and tower were renovated between 2017 and 2021, during which the bells remained silent (with a few exceptions).[10]

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 39
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside
*Materials and textures without shaders are available in the exported files.
*The Studio, materials and camera/door animations are included in the Blender file that is used to create all realtime renders for this car. everything in this file is set up, you only have to move the camera and click ''render''. (roughness is generated with the default texture file)
*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.
*The car is royalty free, so you are free to modify and use it in any (commercial) project as much as you want.
*Objects: 50
File formats: (all file formats are exported with blender 2.8 default settings)*abc *blend *dae *fbx *obj *stl 
[Options]Car Body: Mid Size 4 door sedan
Engine: (Engine block can be removed to simulate an electric car, the mechanical parts under the hood will remain)V6
Sport pack:Yes (Rear wheels wider than front wheels, Wider body, Larger wheels, Larger engine with more cilinders, Upgraded hood, Larger brakes with red calipers, Added front and rear bumper lips and sideskirts, Flat bottom steering wheel)
Front bumper:Tier 7
Rear bumper:Tier 5
Dashboard:Tier 2
Exhaust:Tier 1
Wheels:Tier 1
Glass Roof:Yes
Seats:Comfort Seats
Executive rear seats with table and screens:No
Trim Color:Glossy chrome
Interior Leather Color:White
Tinted Rear Windows:Yes
Wheel Color:Grey

description_text:
Car Name: SHC MCE 38
This car is rendered in realtime in Blender Eevee, to open the native Blender file, you will need Blender 2.8.
The price of this car is calculated on it's combination of parts and options in relationship to other MCE cars.The lower priced MCE cars have the same building quality as the higher priced ones, but the overal look and used parts will be better on the higher priced MCE cars.This allows me to release cars at accessable prices, and release better looking ones at a higher price. (all options for this car are listed at the bottom of the description) 
This car is made with the SHC modular car creation tool.
Custom designed parts im a high detailed brandless/generic car with real modern cars inspiration that can be used for renders, presentations, real time apps and video games without displaying or copying any real life car model.
*Detailed exterior
*Detailed interior (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed engine (can be removed to lower polycount)
*Detailed underside

description_text:
The National Monument or abbreviated as Monas or Tugu Monas is a 132 meter* (433 ft) high memorial monument that was erected to commemorate the resistance and struggle of the** Indonesian people to seize independence from the Dutch East Indies colonial rule.** The construction of this monument began on August 17, 1961 under the orders of president Soekarno and opened to the public on July 12, 1975. The monument is crowned with flames covered with gold sheets which symbolizes the** flaming fighting spirit of the Indonesian people.** The National Monument is located right in the middle of Medan Merdeka Square, Central Jakarta.This model represents Monas during nighttime and this model has nice detail as a low poly. 
Currently, the model didn't have a real-life scale*

Resume everything, you are going to buy It's a model that can be use and reused and It will fits in anything that you make it without trouble and saving thousands of time.
More Details

*The car is linked into several objects to make it more suitable for animations, opening doors, rigging and modifying / tuning / customizing.

description_text:
A single, drop‑in awards asset that combines a wooden stairs/podium stand with a gold trophy at center. The file includes four optional trophy designs you can swap in, so you get one cohesive model with easy style variations—ideal for sports promos, victory screens, event stages, motion graphics, and games.
What’s included

  - 1 assembled asset: stairs/podium stand with “WINNER” plaque and trophy

  - 4 optional trophy variants (classic, spiral, modern, etc.) included in the same file for quick swapping

  - Formats: Blender (.blend), FBX, OBJ (+MTL), glTF 2.0

  - High‑resolution PBR textures for wood and metal (BaseColor, Roughness, Metallic, Normal, AO)

Features

  - Clean topology and non‑overlapping UVs

  - you can change texts

  - Real‑world scale and centered pivots for easy placement

  - Materials set up for Blender (Cycles/Eevee) and easily portable to other DCCs/engines

  - Game/render ready; works great for real‑time and high‑res stills

How to use the variants

  - Blender: toggle the included trophy collections/objects (Trophy_01–Trophy_04) to switch styles

  - FBX/OBJ/glTF: all trophy variants are included as separate named meshes within the same asset for quick selection

Notes

  - Preview lighting/HDR and sparkles are for presentation only

  - Any branded logos shown in previews are not included; the “WINNER” plaque is included. I can provide a blank plaque or custom engraving on request

description_text:
this is a model of a city rendered in blender cycles, this is useful for desktop backgrounds, landscape renderings etc. This model has micro displacement setup which is used for the greeble  on the floor.
All buildings in the blend file are created by using objects modeled in blender using a particle system to distribute them. The fbx and obj file have the particle objects converted to mesh. 
In addition to the blender file I also provided an obj and an fbx file for use with programs other than blender.
The blend file has a compositing node setup which was used to create the glare and compositing effects for the final render. materials are all procedural and no image textures were used, all procedural textures were created with nodes in blender.

description_text:
A dirty, filled with rust, old and worn metal Chain Link Fence 3d model. Perfect for city scapes, military bases, or anything you'd like to keep intruders out of! This is a high quality, low poly game asset that was modeled in Blender 2.8.2. Its normal map was baked from a high poly model, making it look very detailed without using too many polygons. This model comes with the native .blend file and the Substance Painter native texture file .spp, meaning you can adjust it to your liking(NOT FOR RE-DISTRIBUTION).
< USAGE >
This model is intended for asset usage, realtime / background and design visualization. Renders were done in Substance Painter 2020 and wireframes in Blender.
< GENERAL >

  -     High quality UV unwrap.

  -     The mesh object was centered on the scene.

  -     Mesh transforms(scale, rotation, location) were reset to their respective uniform values.

  -     There is one object on the scene itself.

  -     Comes in 7 different file formats: MAX, 3DS, FBX, OBJ, SPP, DXF, STL, ABC, USDC.

< TEXTURES >
The textures are in 2K resolution and in PNG file format.
Textures are PBR (Physically Based Rendering).
The textures come in 5 different formats(all in 2K resolution):

  -     PBR Metallic Roughness(BaseColor, Height, Metallic, Normal, Roughness).

  -     Unity HDRP Metallic Standard(BaseMap, MaskMap, Normal).

  -     Unity URP Metallic Standard(AlbedoTransperancy, MetallicSmoothness, Normal).

  -     Unreal Engine 4 Packed(BaseColor, Normal, OcclusionRoughnessMetallic).

  -     Unreal Engine 4 SSS Packed(BaseColor, Normal, OcclusionRoughnessMetallic).

Using the Substance Painter .SPP file you can export the textures at a higher or lower resolution to your liking, or, in case you don't work with Substance Painter, send me a request and I'll add textures in different qualities.
< GEOMETRY >

  -     Polygons: 2808.

  -     Faces: 1386.

  -     Vertices: 1804.

Please Rate this product if you are satisfied.

description_text: The Kalinin K-7 (Russian: Калинин К-7; Ukrainian: Калінін К-7) was a heavy experimental aircraft designed and tested in the Soviet Union in the early 1930s. It was of unusual configuration with twin booms and large underwing pods housing fixed landing gear and machine gun turrets. In the passenger version, seats were arranged inside the 2.3-meter thick (7 ft 7 in) wings. The airframe was welded from KhMA chrome-molybdenum steel. The original design called for six engines in the wing leading edge but when the projected loaded weight was exceeded, two more engines were added to the trailing edges of each wing, one right and one left of the central passenger pod.[1] Nemecek states in his book that at first only one further pusher engine was added (Source Wikipedia)

description_text: The Kawasaki Ki-61 Hien (flying swallow) was a Japanese World War II fighter aircraft used by the Imperial Japanese Army Air Force. The first encounter reports claimed Ki-61s were Messerschmitt Bf 109s: further reports claimed that the new aircraft was an Italian design, which led to the Allied reporting name of Tony, assigned by the United States War Department. The Japanese Army designation was Army Type 3 Fighter. It was the only mass-produced Japanese fighter of the war to use a liquid-cooled inline V engine. Over 3,000 Ki-61s were produced. Initial prototypes saw action over Yokohama during the Halsey-Doolittle Raid on 18. April 1942, and continued to fly combat missions throughout the war (Source Wikipedia)

description_text: The Douglas X-3 Stiletto was a 1950s United States experimental jet aircraft with a slender fuselage and a long tapered nose, manufactured by the Douglas Aircraft Company. Its primary mission was to investigate the design features of an aircraft suitable for sustained supersonic speeds, which included the first use of titanium in major airframe components. Douglas designed the X-3 with the goal of a maximum speed of approximately 2,000 m.p.h,[2] but it was, however, seriously underpowered for this purpose and could not even exceed Mach 1 in level flight.[3] Although the research aircraft was a disappointment, Lockheed designers used data from the X-3 tests for the Lockheed F-104 Starfighter which used a similar wing design in a successful Mach 2 fighter. description_text: The Westland Whirlwind (Whirly or Whirlibomber in RAF slang) was a British twin-engined heavy fighter developed by Westland Aircraft. It was the Royal Air Force's first single-seat, twin-engined, cannon-armed fighter, and a contemporary of the Supermarine Spitfire and Hawker Hurricane. overview: A detailed model, replicating a late Penny Farthing bycycle; interestingly featuring pneumatic tyres and sprung seat.
description_text:
Overview
A detailed model, replicating a late Penny Farthing bycycle; interestingly featuring pneumatic tyres and sprung seat. 
Features

  - 90k poly detail

  - Textures include Colour, Gloss, Reflection and Normal maps for PBR workflow.

  - Highly accurate

History
The penny-farthing, also known as a high wheel, high wheeler and ordinary, was the first machine to be called a bicycle. It was popular in the 1870s and 1880s, with its large front wheel providing high speeds (owing to it travelling a large distance for every rotation of the legs) and comfort (the large wheel provides greater shock absorption). It became obsolete from the late 1880s with the development of modern bicycles, which provided similar speed amplification via chain-driven gear trains and comfort through pneumatic tyres, and were marketed in comparison to penny-farthings as safety bicycles due to the reduced danger of falling and the reduced height to fall from.

description_text:
1/1800th scale Town class destroyer model. Certain elements not to scale.
The Town-class were a set of assorted lend-lease destroyers transferred to the United Kingdom from the United States. They were formerly of the Wickes, Clemson, and Cadwell classes and were given various refits to suit the British needs.
This model is designed and tested at 1/1800th scale, but up-scaling and down-scaling are possible. Since the model is optimized for 1/1800th scale, it is not ideal to print larger versions due to a lack of detail. The gun barrels and mast have been enlarged.
This model includes three designs, HMS Stanley from USS McCalla (Clemson Class), HMS Georgetown from USS Maddox (Wickes Class), and HMS Lewes from USS Craven (Cadwell Class).
This is part of my collection of WWII warships, keep an eye out for more to come. If you have a specific request, message me and I'll bump it up my list.
Tested with PLA at .08mm layer height with .4mm nozzle.

description_text: The Vega is a six-passenger high-wing monoplane airliner built by the Lockheed Corporation starting in 1927. It became famous for its use by a number of record-breaking pilots who were attracted to the rugged and very long-range design. description_text:
The B-17 Flying Fortress was famed across the world during WWII. Its large bomb load, accuracy, long range, defensive armament, and overall good survivability all contributed to it being one of the most recognizable aircraft of all time.
This is a 2D cutout for use in 3D programs. It has both a head on and a rearward view. Ideal for orthagraphic projections.
Materials are very basic, and only included in the .blend file. However, they can very easily be recreated in about any target engine. Available in a variety of file formats. This cut out contains 1,346 Vertices and has 2,536 Triangles. Entire mesh is triangluated instead of quads (which would be 1876 in number). Example of usage can be seen here: https://www.redbubble.com/shop/ap/40311834

description_text:
Low-poly bee skep for traditional bee keeping. A skep is a domed basket to house honey bees. European beekeepers switched from hollowed out logs to straw skeps around 800 AD. It’s made from all natural material like straw or hay bundles that are wrapped around a hollow dome. These bundles are stitched together with blackberry cane, which was split in half first. A slit of about 15 cm enables bees to enter and exit the structure.
*UPDATE 2022-04-25: *

  - made textures PBR

The file includes:

  - Cover scene is NOT included.

Further Information
Model is:

  - Fully mapped and textured with 2 tiling PBR-Textures (each 512x512).

  - In real world scale (meters).

  - Named.

FEATURES-Both of Model is a set of 16 seperated object-High quality polygonal model, correctly scaled for an accurate representation of the original object.-Stone_Lentern 71172 Polygon-Stone_Lentern 71154 VertexPrewiew rendered with Maya RedshiftRedshift Standart Materials onlyModel has real world scale and is centered at near 0,0,0Clean mesh edge loop,quads onlyObjects,Metarials, Textures use meaningful names( striped texture path names)-Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.
DEMENTIONStone_Lentern ( Height 163 CM ,64.173 INCH )
TEXTURES DETAILAll textures are hand painted with substence painter and photoshop4096x 4096 These (Basecolor,Roughness,Normal and Metallic maps)Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency.Maya model are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.
FILE FORMATS
The Maya ALL formats are set with the'3' button for the geometry aproximation preview and renderOrginal Maya format (.MA)

  - Maya 2018

  - OBJ (Multi Format) is directly exported from maya

  - FBX - (Multi formats) is directly exported from maya

The Maya 2018 formats are ready to render exactly Redshift (version 2.6.53 ) and other render engines.

description_text:
3D model of the simple industrial hall. 
Model contains both exterior and interior of the building.
Watch a youtube video preview for better view of the building and its interior.
Model was made using Blender 2.82 so the native format is .blend.
Model contains all parts of the steel supporting structure of the building including steel: columns, beams, roof trusses, reinforced concrete spot-footings of the columns.
Model is made in real scale [m]. 
Building has two naves, one main and one smaller adjacent. Building has two big entrance gates. 
Length of the building is 62,9 m, width 40,8 m, height 10,8 m.
Interior contains all parts of the steel supporting structure, loading system in the form of two big gantries including their supporting system in the form of skeletal columns and gantry beams. Interior has modelled and defined light sources and fixtures for night scenes. The same goes for the exterior which has defined facade lights. Walls and roof are designed as made of sandwich panels with interior insulation. Floor is designed as concrete slab with drainage in the form of manholes distributed evenly through the floor surface. 
Model has defined simple materials which are applied to different parts of the building so it is very  easy to change color  or texture of the diffrent parts of the building.
Model contains scene in which building is divided into three segments so it is possible to create longer or shorter building. Segments are also divided into few main parts so it is possible to add a bit of customization and create slightly diffrent structure.
Mesh is almost entirely made of quads.

description_text:
Concrete Barriers 
A Jersey barrier, Jersey wall, or Jersey bump is a modular concrete or plastic barrier employed to separate lanes of traffic. It is designed to minimize vehicle damage in cases of incidental contact while still preventing vehicle crossovers resulting in a likely head-on collision. Jersey barriers are also used to reroute traffic and protect pedestrians and workers during highway construction. They are named after the U.S. state of New Jersey which first started using the barriers as separators between lanes of a highway in the 1950s.
Features:

  - Clean topology and only quads.

  - One different materials are included.

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - All objects have fully unwrapped UVs.

  - Renders have no post-processing.

  - All the objects of the model are named.

-Both of Model is a set of 4 seperated object

Redshift Standart Materials only

Clean mesh edge loop,quads only
Objects,Metarials, Textures use meaningful names( striped texture path names)

Metal Trashcan ( Height 78 CM  -  30.708 INCH  Diameter 52 CM -20.472 INCH  )

Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. 
Maya model are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.
FILE FORMATS

  - Maya 2018

  - OBJ (Multi Format)  is directly exported from maya

description_text:
Concrete Barriers 
A Jersey barrier, Jersey wall, or Jersey bump is a modular concrete or plastic barrier employed to separate lanes of traffic. It is designed to minimize vehicle damage in cases of incidental contact while still preventing vehicle crossovers resulting in a likely head-on collision. Jersey barriers are also used to reroute traffic and protect pedestrians and workers during highway construction. They are named after the U.S. state of New Jersey which first started using the barriers as separators between lanes of a highway in the 1950s.
Features:

  - Clean topology and only quads.

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

description_text:
Concrete Barriers 
A Jersey barrier, Jersey wall, or Jersey bump is a modular concrete or plastic barrier employed to separate lanes of traffic. It is designed to minimize vehicle damage in cases of incidental contact while still preventing vehicle crossovers resulting in a likely head-on collision. Jersey barriers are also used to reroute traffic and protect pedestrians and workers during highway construction. They are named after the U.S. state of New Jersey which first started using the barriers as separators between lanes of a highway in the 1950s.
Features:

  - Clean topology and only quads.

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

  - Model does not include any backgrounds or scenes used in preview images.

  - All objects have fully unwrapped UVs.

  - Preview renders were made in: Substain Painter and MarmosetToolbag.

  - All the objects of the model are named.

  - One UVW.

Textures:

  - Material Base Color, Height, Metallic, Normal, Roughness.

  - Resolution: 4096x4096.

description_text:
Descripción Técnica y Comercial Expandida (Copia y pega desde aquí):This is a premium, highly detailed, and professionally engineered 3D architectural model of the Edificio de conferencias y exposiciones artísticas y culturales (Conference and Art Exhibition Building). Developed originally within a native CAD/BIM-friendly environment using SketchUp, this contemporary architectural landmark masterfully synthesizes cutting-edge organic minimalism with highly optimized, functional interior programming. It is custom-tailored to serve as a high-fidelity spatial solution for premium artistic galleries, cultural summits, corporate conventions, and institutional events.
Spanning a total footprint area of exactly 404 m², the internal spatial planning utilizes an advanced architectural program designed to maximize uninhibited open-plan exhibition galleries and keynote conference halls. By strategically centralizing the restroom facilities on a standalone core island, the design completely frees up the entire structural perimeter. This layout allows for dynamic, uninterrupted sightlines and fluid visitor circulation. As demonstrated in the interior visualization panels, the architectural envelope is wrapped in expansive, full-height glass curtain walls with customized modular mullions. This architectural feature guarantees dramatic daylight penetration and projects striking, realistic shadow patterns across the interior floor plates, drastically reducing rendering setup times for interior scenes.
DETAILED TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS & ASSET INTEGRITYEngineered strictly to satisfy professional industry standards for high-end architectural visualization (ArchViz), real-time simulation, urban master planning, and virtual scale maquetting:
Geometry & Topology: Highly optimized, clean polygonal geometry. The complex rounded corner transitions and continuous curtain walls have been carefully budgeted to maintain perfectly smooth surface distribution and clean shading.
Polygon Count: 1,400 Polygons (Highly efficient, ideal for quick scene integration without performance overhead).
Vertex Count: 3,437 Vertices.
Mesh Integrity: Subdivision-ready mesh construction. Zero N-gons, no non-manifold geometry, no co-planar faces, and completely free of overlapping vertices or redundant hidden elements.
Scale, Units & Coordinates: Modeled to strict Real-World Scale metrics using the Metric System (Centimeters/Meters). The building fits its precise 404 square meter footprint. The entire model asset has been zeroed out, with its transformation pivots centered perfectly at the world origin coordinates [0,0,0].
Organization & Layer Hierarchy: Professional scene management. All primary architectural components—such as structural perimeter walls, glass panels, curtain wall mullions, exterior concrete roof slabs, interior floor finishes, and core partitions—are isolated into individual, logically named objects and layers for effortless selection, hiding, or editing.
Materials & Textures: Includes all integrated texture maps and materials. Shader slots are assigned cleanly based on physical attributes (Polished Concrete, Transparent Glass Cladding, Premium Interior Flooring, Fine Wood Finishes) ensuring a seamless drag-and-drop workflow in any standard or production-grade render engine (V-Ray, Corona, Cycles, Lumion, Twinmotion, or Unreal Engine).
Production Suitability: Fully modeled interior and exterior architectural program. The asset is perfectly suited for wide-angle exterior master-plan camera flies, detailed interior walk-through animations, close-up interior renderings, and macro urban planning scenarios. (Note: Model is not structurally intended for 3D printing).
CROSS-PLATFORM INTEROPERABILITY & FILES INCLUDEDTo guarantee seamless integration into any 3D production suite, CAD environment, or game engine, this package includes a versatile array of industry-standard 3D file formats:
Native CAD/Surface Format: .SKP (SketchUp source file with fully preserved components, native layer groupings, and pre-saved scene viewports).
Production & Exchange Formats:
.FBX (Universal exchange format preserving accurate geometry data, transformation pivots, and material groupings).

The roman Colosseum with a different base, meant to be filled with weights to keep it underwater. You can fill it with anything and the just slide the Colosseum into the base. I recommend using PET-G for aquariums. ABS can have dangerous chemicals and PLA degrades quicker than PET-G. description_text:

description_text:
It’s a set of 40 marvelous stylized trees in the low poly style. The pack consist of 21 ready elements for self creation and 29 of model platforms, which is over 90 models in total. Det includes FBX Format, Unity Prefabs and Unreal Engine uasset ready to use in any 3D game engine.This assets can be used for commercial projects!
This set includes 40 ready made trees. The whole set is divided into 11 species I worked out. Each has its own 3-4 variants (different branches layout, crown and trunk shapes).
This set consists of:

  - 40 trees

  - 5 roots

  - 13 single separated tree crowns and 8 trunks to own trees creation

  - 13 of heads already mentioned can be used as bushes.

Platforms used in the presentation are only a background for trees. The platforms are made for the purpose of promotion video with the aim of expose the product. But nothing prevents to use these elements to create an interesting and functional level for your easy platform game. Elements of this platform are a free supplement. But stay tuned, I plan to prepare a professional set for building platform games. 

  - 29 elements are a part of this group of model platforms:

  - 16 walls in two colours

  - 10 platforms (slant, steep, flat and wavy)

  - 3 grass-grown rock ledges 

  - 2 raw ledges without plants.

This pack works great with theForest Meadows Pack Stylized Edition http://bit.ly/2O4KIaB
All models names are placed orderly (Object data with the same name like an object).All assets come in FBX format, ready to use in any 3D game engine. All pivots are correctly placed and all meshes are scaled proportionally one to another with frozen transformations, which makes them workable. All fbx files have been remade into prefab without transformation.
Formats

  - Blend

  - UnityPackage

  - fbx

  - uassets (UE4)

This package includes demo with basic scene lightning together with implemented postprocessing and weather settings (sunlight beams, fog, leaves on the wind, glow-worms). 
See the video https://youtu.be/5UkjzZ6FNEo Thanks to this video you will learn how to add to Unity unlit and raw, colourless scene some light with lustrous and vibrant colours like those on the video https://youtu.be/JDOev-H7Lqw and screens. 
PLEASE NOTE that some elements like bridges, signs, trunks, Rocks cobblestones, cross, tent are a part of another set of my own, available at http://bit.ly/2O4KIaB
Here is the link to my **FREE **models I created for you for the needs of  trailerDownload: http://bit.ly/2O7p06zDownload: http://bit.ly/2Nr4ugn

description_text:
The PRE-FABRICATED CONCRETE PANEL RESIDENTIAL BUILDING model is just for the exterior scenes. NO furniture inside.
The asset consists of 10 pre-fabricated panel buildings (32 floors), which have the same volume, but are fully randomized. Check the previews.
In the asset there are 10 files, so just import the file into your scene.
The model is textured for the CoronaRenderer 7.
Every building has lights inside as well. So before the render add SetupLightMix, so you can control the lights of the building (in the LightMix you are going to have all light of the building on one layer).
It could be helpful for creating a city for the drone views and for exterior vizualisations as well.

I will be thankful for your comments and reviews.

description_text:
Intended for 3d print.
This model pack includes a couple of different versions of the Swedish skyscraper Karlatornet, scheduled for completion in 2024. See detailed list below.
Detailed List:This model pack includes the following models:

  - Basic model - just a depiction of the skyscraper, without additional functions. Suggested use is as scenery in tabletop wargames, or simply as a decoration to place in your bookcase. 

  - Pencil Holder - can hold a basic, 6-sided graphite pencil. The pencil holder is prescaled to hold a pencil that is 7mm in diameter. But I strongly suggest that you inspect and adjust the scale as needed before printing. 

  - Undecorated Keychain version - a skyskraper model with a keychain attached, for putting on your keyring.

  - Keychain, text version - Same as above, but with some basic info about the building written along its side (name, height, number of floors and date of completion).

  - Model with ring - the basic model, but with a small ring on its underside. Can be used for a variety of purposes.

File formats:
The models in this pack are included in both .stl and .obj format
About Karlatornet:
The name translates -roughly- to Big Dipper Tower. Construction began in Göteborg, Sweden in 2018, and is scheduled for completion in 2024. At the time of writing this, construction is still ongoing, but that may have changed by the time You are reading this.At 245 metres and 73 floors, once completed Karlatornet will be the tallest building in Scandinavia. Its most distinguishing features are arguably its four twisting wall sections about two thirds of the way to the top, and its four-pronged crown.The skyscraper is designed by the American architectural firm Skidmore, Owings & Merrill, that also designed the One World Trade Center. The main contractor responsible for construction is Serneke Group AB.Karlatornet is part of a larger collection of high-rises, and will be accompanied by shorter neighboring buildings named Cassiopeja, Auriga and Virgo. Note that there are a number of substantially shorter buildings connecting to Karlatornet - these are not present in the models included in this product.
Also note: I am in no way affiliated with Serneke, Skidmore, Owings & Merrill, the municipality of Göteborg or anyone else involved with Karlatornet.

description_text:
In this package you will find a rough asphalt material, as you would find it on streets, and a smoothed out mix of asphalt and concrete, as you would find it in a parking lot or street transition.
The contained materials are of high quality (2048x2048), use the Physically Based Rendering approach and are ready-to-use with the Standard Shader in Unity. Of course, all necessary textures are provided, so feel free to use these material in any other 3D rendering software as well.
The materials are seamlessly tileable and great for your realistic outdoor areas. The original footage was shot in Japan.

description_text:
A kerosene lamp is a type of lighting device that uses kerosene as a fuel. Invented by the Polish pharmacist Ignacy Łukasiewicz in 1853, kerosene lamps have a wick or mantle as light source, protected by a glass chimney or globe; lamps may be used on a table, or hand-held lanterns may be used for portable lighting. Like oil lamps, they are useful for lighting without electricity, such as in regions without rural electrification, in electrified areas during power outages, at campsites, and on boats. There are three types of kerosene lamp: flat-wick, central-draught (tubular round wick), and mantle lamp. Kerosene lanterns meant for portable use have a flat wick and are made in dead-flame, hot-blast, and cold-blast variants.
Suitable for mobile, AR, VR and PC. Works with Unreal Engine 4 and Unity.

description_text:
Lover pendant ready for 3D print and production.
WIKI :
Origins of symbolHeart-shaped peepal leaves were used in artistic depictions of the Indus Valley Civilisation: a heart pendant originated from there has been discovered and is now exhibited in Delhi national museum.[citation needed] In the 6th-5th century BC, the heart shape was used to represent the heart-shaped fruit of the plant Silphium,[1] a plant possibly used as a contraceptive.[2] Many species in the parsley family have estrogenic properties, and some, such as wild carrot, were used to induce abortion.[3] Silver coins from Cyrene of the 6–5th BC bear a similar design, sometimes accompanied by a silphium plant and is understood to represent its seed or fruit.[4]
Earliest use
The earliest known possible visual depiction of a heart symbol, as a lover hands his heart to the beloved lady, in a manuscript of the Roman de la poire, mid-13th century.The combination of the heart shape and its use within the heart metaphor developed at the end of the Middle Ages, although the shape has been used in many ancient epigraphy monuments and texts. With possible early examples or direct predecessors in the 13th to 14th century, the familiar symbol of the heart represented love developed in the 15th century, and became popular in Europe during the 16th.[5] Before the 14th century, the heart shape was not associated with the meaning of the heart metaphor. The geometric shape itself is found in much earlier sources, but in such instances does not depict a heart, but typically foliage: in examples from antiquity fig leaves, and in medieval iconography and heraldry typically the leaves of ivy and of the water-lily. One possible early use in the 11th century could be found in the manuscript, Al-Maqamat written by Al Hariri of Basra. The manuscript includes an illustration of a farewell greeting between two men while astride their camels, with the heart shape seen prominently over their heads.[6][not in citations given]
The first known depiction of a heart as a symbol of romantic love dates to the 1250s. It occurs in a miniature decorating a capital 'S' in a manuscript of the French Roman de la poire (National Library FR MS. 2086, plate 12). In the miniature a kneeling lover (or more precisely, an allegory of the lover's sweet gaze or douz regart) offers his heart to a damsel. The heart here resembles a pine cone (held upside down, the point facing upward), in accord with medieval anatomical descriptions. However, in this miniature what suggests a heart shape is only the result of a lover's finger superimposed on an object; the full shape outline of the object is partly hidden, and therefore unknown. Moreover, the French title of the manuscript that features the miniature translates into Novel Of The Pear in English. Thus the heart shaped object would be a pear; the conclusion that a pear represents a heart is dubious. Opinions therefore differ over this being the first depiction of a heart as symbol of romantic love.[7] Giotto in his 1305 painting in the Scrovegni Chapel (Padua) shows an allegory of charity (caritas) handing her heart to Jesus Christ. This heart is also depicted in the pine cone shape based on anatomical descriptions of the day (still held upside down). Giotto's painting exerted considerable influence on later painters, and the motive of Caritas offering a heart is shown by Taddeo Gaddi in Santa Croce, by Andrea Pisano on the bronze door of the south porch of the Baptisterium in Florence (c. 1337), by Ambrogio Lorenzetti in the Palazzo Publico in Siena (c. 1340) and by Andrea da Firenze in Santa Maria Novella in Florence (c. 1365). The convention of showing the heart point upward switches in the late 14th century and becomes rare in the first half of the 15th century.[7]
The scalloped shape of the now-familiar heart symbol, with a dent in its base, arises in the early 14th century, at first only lightly dented, as in the miniatures in Francesco Barberino's Documenti d'amore (before 1320). A slightly later example with a more pronounced dent is found in a manuscript from the Cistercian monastery in Brussels (MS 4459–70, fol 192v. Royal Library of Belgium). The convention of showing a dent at the base of the heart thus spread at about the same time as the convention of showing the heart with its point downward.[8] The modern indented red heart has been used on playing cards since the late 15th century.[9]
Various hypotheses attempted to connect the heart shape as it evolved in the Late Middle Ages with instances of the geometric shape in antiquity.[10] Such theories are modern, proposed from the 1960s onward, and they remain speculative, as no continuity between the supposed ancient predecessors and the late medieval tradition can be shown. Specific suggestions include: the shape of the seed of the silphium plant, used in ancient times as a(n) herbal contraceptive,[10][11] and stylized depictions of features of the human female body, such as the female's breasts, buttocks, pubic mound, or spread vulva.[12]

Stan Lee (born Stanley Martin Lieber /ˈliːbər/; December 28, 1922 – November 12, 2018) was an American comic book writer, editor, publisher, and producer. He rose through the ranks of a family-run business to become Marvel Comics' primary creative leader for two decades, leading its expansion from a small division of a publishing house to a multimedia corporation that dominated the comics industry.
In collaboration with others at Marvel—particularly co-writer/artists Jack Kirby and Steve Ditko—he co-created numerous popular fictional characters, including superheroes Spider-Man, the X-Men, Iron Man, Thor, the Hulk, Black Widow, the Fantastic Four, Black Panther, Daredevil, Doctor Strange, Scarlet Witch and Ant-Man. The superheroes he created seemed more meaningful and realistic.[2] In doing so, he pioneered a more naturalistic approach to writing superhero comics in the 1960s, and in the 1970s he challenged the restrictions of the Comics Code Authority, indirectly leading to changes in its policies. In the 1980s he pursued the development of Marvel properties in other media, with mixed results. Following his retirement from Marvel in the 1990s, he remained a public figurehead for the company, and frequently made cameo appearances in films and television shows based on Marvel characters, on which he received an executive producer credit. Meanwhile, he continued independent creative ventures into his 90s, until his death in 2018.
Lee was inducted into the comic book industry's Will Eisner Award Hall of Fame in 1994 and the Jack Kirby Hall of Fame in 1995. He received the NEA's National Medal of Arts in 2008.

description_text:
A Celtic coin. Animated. PBR Materials.
Celtic art is generally used by art historians to refer to the art of the La Tène period across Europe, while the Early Medieval art of Britain and Ireland, that is what Celtic art evokes for much of the general public, is called Insular art in art history. Both styles absorbed considerable influences from non-Celtic sources, but retained a preference for geometrical decoration over figurative subjects, which are often extremely stylized when they do appear; narrative scenes only appear under outside influence. Energetic circular forms, triskeles, and spirals are characteristic. Much of the surviving material is in precious metal, which no doubt gives a very unrepresentative picture, but apart from Pictish stones and the Insular high crosses, large monumental sculpture, even with decorative carving, is very rare; possibly it was originally common in wood. Celts were also able to create developed musical instruments such as the carnyces, these famous war trumpets used before the battle to frighten the enemy, as the best-preserved found in Tintignac (Gaul) in 2004 and which were decorated with a boar head or a snakehead.

title: HDR 360 Panorama 1st Street Viaduct DTLA 25 tracks 3D model
description_text:
This is a 32-bit floating point 360 degree HDR panoramic lat long image of a Downtown Los Angeles landmark called 1st Street bridge.  Shot at 8am in the morning on a very sunny day for big blue sky, bright low sun, and hard shadows.  This image can be used in any 3D package for Image Based Lighting IBL.  The full range of light in this scene is contained in the HDR image and will be strong enough to illuminate your 3D scene and cast hard shadows.  I shot this 8 level exposure wedge, with a range from 1/4th sec to 1/4000 in step size of 2 full EV’s.  That gives a range of over 12 EV’s of light in this one exterior pano.  To see a full rez version and fly around the scene close up please search Tojek_VFX on 360cities website.  Exact location of the shot is Downtown Los Angeles, CA, google map latlong, 34.0479269,-118.2299212,

3D Photorealistic Low Poly models of Wooden Table. Models are all optimized for real-time render (Game, VR, AR, etc). Objects was made according to references. Correctly scaled for an accurate representation in real world (in cm unit). Fully tested in all formats included. Triangulated meshes. Origins are set to bases of objects, and centre of the world. Models includes 3 LODs (LOD0, LOD1, LOD2)

  - Created with Blender 3.3.1

  - Textured in Substance Painter

  - Rendered in Marmoset Toolbag

  - Format : blend, fbx, obj, uasset, unitypackage

  - Unit scale : cm

  - Polycounts : 

  - - 4388 tris (LOD0)

  - - 2020 tris (LOD1)

  - - 1652 tris (LOD2)

  - Textures : 

  - - 2048 x 2048 PBR textures in PNG format

  - - Base color/Albedo map

  - - Normal map (OpenGL & DirectX)

  - - Roughness map

  - - AO (Ambient Oclussion) map

  - Channel-packed textures : 

  - - ARM : 

  - - -A = Ambient Oclussion map, Red channel

  - - -R = Roughness map, Green channel

  - - Mask Map :

  - - -Ambient Oclussion Green channel

  - - -Smoothness map (inversion of Roughness map), Blue channel

Any question or feedback are welcome
We greatly appreciate you choosing our 3D models and hope they will be of use. We look forward to continuously dealing with you. Sincerely Yours, LiquidPixel Studio

title: HDR 360 Panorama DTLA Graffiti Alley Cloudy 017 3D model
description_text:
HDR 360 Panorama DTLA Graffiti Alley Cloudy 017This is a 32-bit floating point 360 degree HDR panoramic equirectangular image of a Downtown Los Angeles industrial alley that is covered in beautiful graffiti.  Shot at 9am in the morning on a very cloudy day for flat strong ambient light with no hard shadows.  This image can be used in any 3D package for Image Based Lighting IBL.  The full range of light in this scene is contained in the HDR image and will be strong enough to illuminate your 3D scene and cast shadows.  I shot this 8 level exposure wedge, with a range from 1/4th sec to 1/4000 in step size of 2 full EV’s.  That gives a range of over 12 EV’s of light in this one exterior pano.  Stop down the image in Nuke and check with the eyedropper to see the full range of pixel values in the double digits throughout the sky.  To see a full rez version and fly around the scene close up please search Tojek_VFX on 360cities website.  Exact location of the shot is Los Angeles, CA, google map latlong, 34.0322028,-118.23280833338505

Hello , my dear customer
I am Happy to present you Ashtray bin 3d model ready for renders and animation that model will definitely save you a lot of time.

Mat_Main (4K textures)
UVs:

  - The UV layout is 100% unwrapped.

  - All UVs are non-Overlapping.

Base color.png (4096x4096px) - metal/rough

Sincerely Yours,

description_text:
The Azerbaijani tar and the skills related to this tradition play a significant role in shaping the cultural identity of Azerbaijanis. The Tar is a long-necked plucked lute, traditionally crafted and performed in communities throughout the Republic of Azerbaijan and the Iranian Azerbaijan region. The tar features alone or with other instruments in numerous traditional musical styles. It also considered by many to be the country’s leading musical instrument.
In 2012, the craftsmanship and performance art of the tar was added to the UNESCO's List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.
Performers hold the instrument horizontally against the chest and pluck the strings with a plectrum, while using trills and a variety of techniques and strokes to add colour. Tar performance has an essential place in weddings and different social gatherings, festive events and public concerts. Players transmit their skills to young people within their community by word of mouth and demonstration, and at educational musical institutions.

title: HDR 360 Panorama 1st Street Viaduct DTLA 49 side of river 3D model
description_text:
This is a 32-bit floating point 360 degree HDR panoramic lat long image of a Downtown Los Angeles landmark called 1st Street bridge.  Shot at 8am in the morning on a very sunny day for big blue sky, bright low sun, and hard shadows.  This image can be used in any 3D package for Image Based Lighting IBL.  The full range of light in this scene is contained in the HDR image and will be strong enough to illuminate your 3D scene and cast hard shadows.  I shot this 8 level exposure wedge, with a range from 1/4th sec to 1/4000 in step size of 2 full EV’s.  That gives a range of over 12 EV’s of light in this one exterior pano.  To see a full rez version and fly around the scene close up please search Tojek_VFX on 360cities website.  Exact location of the shot is Downtown Los Angeles, CA, google map latlong, 34.0479269,-118.2299212,
